{{TierBar}}


'''Deterrent Parasites''' are a Tier of [[Mobs#Parasites|Parasites]]. This Tier currently contains 5 Mobs, and killing all of them at least once grants the player the {{AdvancementLink|Deterrent}}.

Deterrent Parasites are responsible for "deterring" enemies from the parasite that spawns them.

== ''Shared Aspects and Capabilities'' ==

=== Spawning ===
*Spawned by [[Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] or [[Pure Parasites|Pure]] parasites, whether directly or indirectly, as defense.

=== Weakness ===
Like all Parasites, Deterrent present a weakness to fire (damage inflicted by fire is quadrupled). 

=== Capabilities ===
*Deterrent Parasites, despite being incapable of movement, act as a line for defense for [[Nexus Parasites]], or in the case of [[Seizer|Seizers]], as aids for [[Pure Parasites]]. 

{{Properties
|tier=Deterrent
|ref=[[Seizer|Seizers]] have a damage cap of 4.
